name: dbmcp
description: The privacy first MCP server for SQL databases.

config_file.title: Config file (full config)
config_file.description: Absolute path to a `dbmcp.yaml`, such as the one the setup skill writes under `~/.claude/plugins/data/dbmcp-haymon-ai/`. Leave the quick-connect fields except Password blank when you use one: they override the same settings in the file.

env_file.title: Env file (full config)
env_file.description: Optional absolute path to a `.env` file holding `DBMCP_*` values and secrets beyond the password, such as an SSH key passphrase or `privacy.key`.

user.title: User (quick connect)
user.description: Database user. Use a least-privilege account.

password.title: Password (quick connect)
password.description: Stored in the macOS Keychain, otherwise in `~/.claude/.credentials.json`.

database.title: Database (quick connect)
database.description: Database name, or the absolute file path for SQLite. Blank on MySQL/PostgreSQL = all databases visible.
